— rtsom rig ṅge mi'i riṅges kyi bsam blo'i chu tshad dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas mtshon byedartso kyi thun mong mayin pa'isgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin la/ de ni dwangs gtsang dri med kyi chu rgyun ring mo zhig dang mtshungs te/ bdud rtsi'i sman dang 'grogs na semās can la dga' bde yid 'ong gi dpadziyon bskrun nus la nag rtsi dug dngasbyar na sems can dang 'khor yug laganod 'tshe yu nga ba byed pa'i rgyu ru yang 'gyur srid pas/ ci 'dir rmem rtog gi rba rlabs zhes pa'i snyan rtsorme gyis —ṅgemene sdi'i gsar rtsomyo yongs sems can la dga' byubade'i dpal yon bskrun pa'i bdud myu'i sman mchog dang 'dra ba'i phan thog par gyur sdig ces gangs — ljongs shes rig nor bu'i slob gling gi dge ming 'dzin pa 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis smon tshig /)bris/snye 2007 12 5

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/༄༅ོ/ /nye lam/ mdo smad bla brang sngags pa grwa tshang gsang chen smin rgyas gling gi gzhon nu rigs pa smra ba o rgyan 'phrin las lags kyis 〈rnam rtog gi rba rlabs〉 zhes pa'i snyan rtsom thor bu'i skor zhig brtsams 'dug pa 'di'i thog nas bltas na/ 'di ni sngags pa grwa tshang rang gi gzi brjid dang dga' 'os pa'i bya ba zhig red/ spyir deng dus nang ba'i grub mtha' spyi dang / khyad par du phyogs 'dir mtshon na gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas dang 'chad nyan gyi bya ba shin tu nyag phra zhing nyams dma' bas ha cang yid 'tsher ba'i gnas su lhung mod/ 'on kyang / o rgyan 'phrin las lags kyi 〈rnam rtog gi rba rlabs〉nyes pa'i snyan deb 'di'i thog nas gsal bor mtshon pa zhig la phyin chad phyogs 'dir gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i khrod du rang re'i bod kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub pa'i skyes bu dam pa gang mang zhig 'byon rgyu yin pa'i ltas bzang zhig red ces brjod na mi chog pa ci yang med/ nang sgos su snyan rtsom

'di'i brjod bya 'dus che zhing rjod byed tshig snyan pas deng dus gzhon skyes rtsom pa bo'i mang bo'i dgos mkho legs par skong thub par ma zad/ da dung snyan rtsom 'dis skye bo mang bor lugs gnyis la 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod dang / rgyang ring la lta ba'i phugs bsam/ mi rigs la bcangs pa'i lhag bsam/ ma 'ongs par dpyod pa'i blo gros sogs dge mtshan dang shes rab kyi sgo mo mi 'dra ba mang bo zhig stsol nges pa zhig yin pas blo ldan kun gyis yid rton par rigs so/ / zhes sngon du gleng ba'i gtam smra ba'i khul byed pa bo ni rngog rgyud 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las so/ / 'dis kyang gangs can mi rigs kyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i shes rig dri ma med pa'i rgyun mi nub dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjid chags dmar bos dran bslangs/dbyings stong ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /gzugs longs sku'i skur bzhengs spyan ras gzigs//thabs sprul sku'i thugs rje bod la bsgyur/ /lha phyag na pad mo snying nas 'dud/ /bod kha ba can gyi yul gru 'dir/ /lha khyod kyis sprul ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /chos mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / /gnas gtsug lag dkar gsal zla ba bsus/ /phyi sra mkhregs zlum gzugs go la'i steng / /mi'i 'gro ba byung ba'i gdod ma nas/ /ri hi ma la yi 'gram rgyud du/ /bod mes pos rlung rta'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /bod thog ma'i rgyal bo gnya' khri nas/ /'bangs byams pas skyong ba'i chos rgyal rnams/ /1

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/gdung bar ma chad par legs byon nas/ /bod 'gro ba'i chos srid dgung la btegs/ /dus de nas gangs can skye 'gro yongs/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /las dge bcu'i phyogs la ci thub 'bad/ /lam blang dor gnas la rim gyis goms/ /nor chog shes brten pa'i gangs can pa/ /sems bag phebs nam yang dga' spros khengs/ /grogs yid 'ong ri skyes rtsed 'jo rol/ /byams snying rje g.yo 'gul med par bsrung / /lha phyag na pad mo'i thugs rjes byin/ /bod 'gro ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa'i mthus/ /yul brjid chags bsod nams g.yang gis gang / /mi kun la lhan skyes byang sems 'khrungs/ /tshul de yi bka' drin dran thengs re/ /mkhar brjid chags dmar po yid la 'khor/ /2

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/gnyid mi khug pa'i gtam rgyud/skad ngag snyan mos cho ga'i dbyangs rta gyer bzhin/ /rigs dang krogs dang bsdongasponas rong 'broganyuladug/gus 'dud dad mos che ba'i rang rigs 'tsho bas/ /nying bcud zas kyi mchod pa nged tsho phul yong / /chos dang 'jig rten gang la mig ltos bral nas/ /rang tshod skyid kyi snang ba dgung la zug pas/ /lang tsho stong shi thebs pa'i khrel 'das dpung gis/ /'gan babs 'ju thag sne mo lha la bsrings 'dug /skabs shig tshor ba'i dbang rtsa sbrid pa sangs nas/ /nam rgyun mthong ba'i rang gi nam mkha' bltas dus/ /mkha' dbyingaspode nithogasporegabakag gsuyoldanapadze+e/mgo bo dgye dbang bral ba'i 'gag 'phrang zhig go /de na nyi ma ser po'i 'od snang bkag nas/ /mun pa grogs su bsten pa'i ci 'dod dpung gis/ /mna' 'brel nyam chung me tog khyur mid gtong bzhin/ /drang bden zhi bde rtsod bzhin sngon la rgyug gi /4

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sa srod dus tshigs skya bo'i mya ngan thang gi / lus sems gzeb tu tshud pa'i bye'u chung khyu yis / /gna' bo'i ras sbra smig po'i bsil drodo bar na/ /bcos min snying gi nyi ma ser bo sgug 'dug /phyi yi rnam pa cung zad mdzes nyams dod nas/ /yod tshad 'khrud byed rdzas kyi 'dag bar 'dod kyang / /nang gi kha dog rgud pa'i zin tho dmar bo/ /gdangs gi sha rus gnyis kyi rkang la thim 'dug /kha dang myu gus ci tsam gleng bar nus pa/ /de la lus dang sems gnyis 'dres par byas yod/ /rigs zhen snying la zug pa'i kha dog dmar pos/ /nam rgyun snang ba skyid po'i rmi lam nyams song / /2006 5 24

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/brtse 'dzum rngul chu thigs pa'i zhabs rjes re nas/ /mtshams sprin li khri'i rgya mtsho bstun mar 'khrungs ki / zhal gsung dri med sbrang char zil ma babs pas/ /rgud pa'i 'jig rten skya bor ljang mdog bskrun song / /gsung chos ra ba nas/ 2005༷ 12༷ 3slus g.yogs pa'i sder mo/brtse 'dzum chems dkar zla ba'i rgyab ljongs su/ /phan gnod nges med chu 'dzin rlung gis g.yo/ /mi mngon lkog tu sbas pa'i gting zab mkha'/ /sus kyang mi rtogs mtha' med gshis su grub/ /ko ba rlon pa'i grang zug mi 'gog kyang / /'dul sbyang byas pa'i slog pa lus la mkho/ /tsha gdung smig rgyus 'thag pa'i g.yul sa ru/ /skom pa'i gzer shugs nyam thag lus la 'khor/ /10

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thang chad rngul chu'i thigs pas smre sngags 'don/ /song zad sems pa dmar po'i ngo gdong phyid/ /mngar skyur 'tsho ba'i rkang lam gnon pa dag /'jigs rung dur thang zhig gis mgron du 'gug /spyang ki mi yi mdun nas zhum zhing 'gro/ /byi la mi yi pang nas dal zhing 'jam/ /tshul 'chos rang gzugs bkab pa'i cho 'phrul 'di'i/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid dmar rjen khrom du bzhag /ljon pa'i skra lo dri bzhon rlung gis 'khyer/ /pha ma'i lang tsho 'jab rkun lo zlas bcom/ /rang gi dmigs bu mi 'dod rkyen gyis 'phrog /yod tshad srid pa'i brgyud rim zhig tu 'khums/ /'gran rtsod gzugs med lag pa ring bo 'dis/ /drang bo'i mi yi glo snying rtsa nas phyung / /bden bden 'dra ba'i mgo lcog ldem na yang / /rdzun gyi rgyab ljongs mthug po su yis rtogs/ /2004༷ 10༷ 1911

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/zla gas nas da pa g.yu chung /'dod pa'i lam sne dgung sngon gnam du zug pa/ /lus sems mthun sgril dam po'i rtsal gyis zin dus/ /bzlog med las dbang dgu tshugs zhags pa dmar bos/ /'grul bzhud dbang lnga'i 'phrul 'khor thang la 'gyel thal/ /sha zhen tshig gis brang khog skya bo brlan kyang / /mi kha rtsub mo'i rlung 'tshub thol gyi ldang ste/ /sdang zhen bsnol mas lang tsho'i 'dzum mdangs bcom dus/ /mngar skyur 'tsho ba'i lkog gyur mig gis zin thal/ /kun snang rlung la spur na a lan med pa/ /'khor ba sdug gi rgya mtsho'i rang gshis yin 'dug /skyo grogs zla ba kho na'i 'dzum la khen nas/ /sna mang sems 'gyu'i khug nas mchi ma thor thal/ /lus kyi mi theg sems kyi tshor 'du mang bos/ /lang tsho gsar ba'i kha dog rgud du bcug kyang / /mdzes pa'i mtha' thug zla ba lha mo'i ngogs nas/ /mthong ba'i g.yu chung brtse ba'i brang la thim thal/ /14

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/'od dpag med pa'i mtshan gsol ba'i/ /srid pa'i tsha gdung gzhom pa'i nyi bsil zhig /khams gsum 'gro ba'i dpal du lham mer gsal/ /thugs sras nyan rang dgra bcom 'phags tshogs sde/ /mkha' yi rgyu skar grangs la co 'dri yang / / sems dpa'i thig le phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /gangs can nyam thag skye 'gro'i snying gi dpyid/ /stong gsum snod kyang dod pa'i mtha' yas 'gro/ /gang gi snying rjes zhags pa'i yongs bzung nas/ /bde chen zag med lam la rab bkod de/ /spro nyams mu tig dkar ba'i tshems phreng gsal//'gro la brtse chen g.yo med thugs kyi ngor/ /'gro don mthar phyin spro sems kun dges kyang / /kye ho da dung sems can bgrang yas dag /sdug bsngal 'obs na zug rngu'i sa chen g.yo/ /snang srid 'od kyi bde dga' mi bzod pa/ /'byung bya'i rten 'byung bca' khrims bsrung ba ltar/ /rgyu 'bras bzlog med chos dbyings gshis lugs 'di/ /spyi mthun las kyis grub pa'i dpang bo nyid/ /mthu stobs mthar son 'jig rten dbang phyug bdag /nyon mongs g.yul dpung thal bar brlag pa'i gnyen/ /tshad med brtse chen rlabs shugs mkha' ru 'phyur/ /sgrib med mig la mchi ma'i do shal 'khrigs/ /ye dag klong nas brdol ba'i dwangs gtsang chab/ /snyim pas bzhes te bden tshig dbyangs dang bcas/ /kun rdzob rten 'byung mthongs su gtor ba'i tshe/ /sum rtsen yul gyi lcam sring cha ru gyur/ /lha dbang sras mo gang ma gang chung zung / /gang chung las kyis 58

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ri mo'i nang tshud nas/ /lha yi me tog mdzes pa'i rgyan bstar bas/ /srol min khrims kyis ma gha dha ru spyugs/ /bya rdzi gsal ba'i rdo rje se'u bcud/ /bu rna'i pad+ma'i khongs su zhugs ba yis/ /zung 'jug bde chen rtse dga'i klong yangs nas/ /bde mchog ma yi sa bon srid 'dir smin/ / bsod nams rin chen sna lnga'i gong bu ru/ /'od zer rtsi bcud 'dzin pa'i bde mchog la/ /rta rdzi phag rdzi khyi rdzi bya rdzi bcas/ /dka' thub phyag rgya bsnams pa'i bu bzhi bltams/ /kun kyang yum gyis bkod 'doms mtsho mo ru/ /'bad brtson las ka'i ba dan rab bsgrengs te/ /longs spyod na da'i grong la slebs gyur bas/ /gtong phod tshogs bsags sgo glegs phye 'chams byung / /yul gyi sa skyong mnga' bdag snyan dbang du/ /bde mchog zhu 'phrin don ldan rgyud mangs sgra/ /gus phyag dbyangs kyis dkrol ba'i sim pa'i dpal/ /bya rung 'dzum mdangs mdzangs ma'i snying du thim/ /las kyis g.yar ba'i phung bo'i 'phrul 'khor 'di/ /dge rtog sems kyis kha lo bsgyur nas ni/ /yum sras gnyis ldan mgrin bzang dang bcas pas/ /rten bzhengs khri 'bangs gsum du tshegs med slebs/ /de tshe phrag dog 'khyog 'gro'i ljags brkyangs ba'i/ /smon log du ma'i dug rlangs 'khor gyur kyang / /sa skyong sems dpa'i bya rung bzlog med gsung / /ston zla 'bring bo g.ya' dag bzhin du gsal/ /bgrang bya gnyis zung 'khor lo'i gru zur nas/ / dus bzhir lhod med brtson pa'i 'bras rtags su/ /thugs rten rin che59

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/na bang rim yongs grub dus/ /dus kyi pho nya yum nyid bsu ru lhags/ /bde mchog ma yi zhal gdams shel dkar phreng / /bu bzhis bkral bar gus pa'i rgyan btags tshe/ /dpag med spro dga' dang bcas lnga lam du/ /zhugs tshe dam tshig lha mo brar sangs rgyas/ /yum gyis lhag bsam pad+mo'i rang mdangs la/ /'byung bzhi snyoms par byed pa'i sras rnams kyis/ /bde garishegs 'od srungs ring bsrel bre gang bcas/ /bum par bzhugs te bya rung mchod rten brtsigs/ /mtho ris mi yi bgrang bya bdun 'khor dus/ /stong gsum mi mjed zhing las rnam rgyal ba'i/ / rmad byung ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i thugs kyi rten//lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpal du bltams/ /dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin gyis/ /dpag med nam mkha'i mdzod yangs rab gtams tshe/ /rnam 'dren 'od srungs bde gshegs rigs lnga dang / /rigs gsum mgon po zhi khro lha yi tshogs//til gyi gang bu kha phye bzhin byon te/ /stong ba'i dbyings las rol mo sna tshogs dang / /dri zhim bdug spos bkra shis me tog char/ /phangs med bsnyil bas kun bzod lan gsum 'dar/ /brtan g.yo gsal mdzad nyi ma'i snang ba che/ /ba spu las 'phros ldog 'od mi dmigs pa'i/ /ye shes 'od snang mtshan mo'i zhag lnga yis/ /ma bzod gzhi dbyings skye med klong du bros/ /mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus thos grol snyan tshig pad+ma dkar po'i phreng mdzes las mchod rten yongs su grub pa dang 60

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rab gnas kyi cho ga bstar pa'i le'u ste dang ba'o/ /rgyal bstan nor 'dzin g.yu yi maṇa ṭar ltor/ /bsod nams mu tig rin chen spungs pa yis/ /rmad byung yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bu bzhis thugs bskyed bzang bo'i cho ga bstar/ /reg med 'ja' tshon khang ba brtsegs pa'i steng / /bde bshegs kha ba babs pa'i mgrin gcig gis/ /skal ldan bu rnams smon lam gang btab pa/ /'grub pa'i dbang bo nged cag mdzad do gsungs/ /de tshe rta rdzis thugs kyi 'od kor lung bstan me long ngogs su 'phros/ /'khyag grang rlung gis kha ba'i 'dab ma gcig tu bsdus te lhun por bzhengs/ /khod snyoms gser ldan chab gtsang grang mo'i gos sngon gdan du bting ba yis/ /byang phyogs yul der rgyal bstan nyi ma 'dren pa'i sa skyong bdag gyur cig /gtam snyan dril chung dbyangs rta'i phye leb phag rdzi'i rna yi bu gar 'dzul/ /de tshe dran 'dzin bye thang skya bo margal ljang gu'i rang mdangs 'tsher/ /phu bos 'dren mchog shākya'i bstan pa skyes sbyangs thos bsam mthar phyin pa'i/ /mkhan chen ming gis sgro 'dogs tshar gcod phu dud btsun par skye bar shog /khyed zung chos srid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab byung mtshams sprin gyis 'khyud 'dug /bdag ni 'char ka'i pad+mo'i sbubs 'khrungs ye dag rgyal sras tshul 'dzin cing / /skye 'chi mnga' brnyes rdo rje sku yis yul de'i bstan la 'khu sems can/ /thal bar brlag nus grub pa'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang 61

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/zhig tu 'gyur bar smon/ /khyi rdzis smon tshig me tog phreng ba'i mtha' chung bya rdzi yid 'phrog nas/ /khyed gsum 'dzugs skyong spel srung byed pa'i ma 'ongs gangs ljongs chos srid kyis/ /mtha' 'khob bod khams bde la 'god dus khyed rnams 'phrad pa'i pho nya ba/ /phrin blon tshul gyis las bcol 'phrin las 'bad med sgrub po bdag gyur cig /de tshe dbang gzhu 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil gyi/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rab 'byams thugs mnyes nas/ /'khor gsum yang dag bden pa'i mtshams sbyar te/ /'od kyi rnam pa'i mchod rten nyid la thim/ /dus der srog lan bskyis pa'i g.yu sprang zhig /las kyis bsdus te rnam dkar zhing der 'byor/ /che ba'i phyag sor rtse nas grongs gyur ba/ /snying rje zhags pas ma 'ongs sras su bzung / /rgyu 'bras khrims kyis gnya' shing rgyan btags pa'i/ /bu bzhi'i zhal ta mgrin bzang de nyid kyis/ /bdag la 'debs pa'i smon lam ci snyam nas/ /ba dan rna zung bsgrengs pa re bas stong / /de tshe zhe sdang ngur sgra chen pos dga' rab dpung la zil shugs bsnan/ /smon log tshig phreng mkha' la gtor bas sems dpa'i tshogs la zug rngu bslangs/ /tshogs bsags yur lam zhing du drangs pa mi gtsang bdud kyis sa rdul drangs/ /blo ldan las grogs bzang bos thos te 'gog par nus pa'i smon tshig gyer/ /'gel byed gnyis 'thung gti mug blo/ /rmongs pa'i rgya ru tshud gyur nas/ /ma 'ongs bstan la smod pa'i tshig /bya rog gcig gis 62

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhom khas blangs/ /bram ze'i khye'u mtshan bzang ser po'i mdangs/ /mnyen sha gsal shing sngon nas dge goms gnyis/ /lhags te dam chos ba kun me tog phon/ /skad gnyis mdzes ma'i 'gram chus 'byed par smon/ /rgyal rigs dpag bsam ljon pa'i yal ga ru/ /shes rab 'bras bu smin pa'i lcam sring gnyis/ / yid bzhin snyim pa'i nor bu 'chang ba yis/ /yig mkhan bstan bcos 'bri bar thogs med shog /gzhan yang tshogs gnyis bsod nams dbyar skyes rnga/ /'dzin pa'i las can gdongs mtha'i khyu mchog gis//rgyal bstan sgro gur gdugs chen 'degs pa la/ / thal sbyar smon lam dri med mang du btab/ /de ltar sngon gyi smon tshig chu gter las/ /bltams pa'i chos srid rgyal mtshan bsgrengs mkhas pa/ /sa skyong khri srong lde btsun khyed nyid ni/ /rta rdzis thugs bskyed bzang bo'i zlos gar legs/ /lung rtogs ngur smrig gos bzang bgos pa dang / /sde snod gsum gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba yis/ /mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa'i skye rgyud ni/ /phag rdzis lhag bsam 'o ma dgrogs las byung / /spros bral chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos par/ /snang srid 'bod sgrogs bran la bkod pa'i dpal/ / rang byung lhun grub pad+ma rgyal bo mchog /khyi rdzis rmad byung 'phrin las gzugs sku yin/ /ke la sha yi da pal be'i ri mo ru/ /za hor dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa dang / /rgya gar paṇa grub mtsho skyes sku mnga' gnyis/ /'dren mdzad sba mi khri gzher bya rdzi'o/ /g.yu sprang phyag sor rtse nas grongs gyur ba/ /snying rje bum pa 63

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/bzang bo'i dkyil 'khor las/ / 'phos pa'i lha lcam pad+ma gsal tshe sku/ / sras mo lha cig mdzangs ma 'di nyid do/ /mgrin bzang log lta'i ku co bsgrogs mkhas pa/ /bdud blon ma zhang khrom pa'i gzugs 'di nyid/ /khyed grogs lha lam mthongs su mchong spobs pa/ /da lta'i chos blon pad+ma gung btsan no/ /glang chen dmyal khams 'grim la tshub blangs ba/ /khyed bgrang gdung rabs gsum par bstan bsnub pa'i//glang dar zhes bya 'byung kyang bya rog gis/ /rnam sprul dpal rdor zhes pas brlag nus so/ /khye'u yid 'ong gser nya 'khyug 'gro zung / /skad gnyis lo tsa ska ba dbal brtsegs dang / / cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan mtshan gsol ba'i/ /gangs ljongs nyi ma'i kha lo thog ma'o/ /smin legs bcu drug cha shas yongs rdzogs pa'i/ / lcam sring gnyis kyis ngag snyan g.yas 'khyil dung / /ldan ma rtse mangs legs byin nyi ma zhes/ /yig mkhan ming gi cod pan dpyangs pa'o/ /ji lta ji snyed 'khor 'das chos kun don/ /skad cig nyid du sgrib med yid kyi mtshor/ /'gog med gsal bar 'char pa'i pad 'byung gis/ /lung bstan dang 'brel mchod rten phan yon gsungs/ /mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus thos grol pad+ma dkar po'i phreng mdzes las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lus bstan nas smon lam btab cing grub pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /smras pa/ bdag blo rmongs mun dra bas nyer bsgribs kyang / /64

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal sras sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes 'brang ste/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi bstsal ba'i bshes rnams kyi/ /zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa'i 'bras rtags tsam/ /ma shes log bshad tshang tshang stug pos gnong / /mtsho byung ngag dbang lha mo'i spyan sngar bshags/ / 'dir 'bad las byung dge ba cung mchis na/ /'gro kun yams nad g.yul las rgyal gyur nas/ /rgyu 'bras phan bde'i srog rtsa rnyed par shog /2003 6 1

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs/mjug gi gtam/7 kun gzhi'i rgya mtsho chen po nas rnam rtog gi rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo ste/ tshogs drug gzugs snang gi yul du chags pa'i kha dog ma nges pa'i sems kyi 'char sgo 'di dag rang byung khams kyi dga' skyo chags sdang gi na bun mthug po zhig dang 'dra bar/'tsho ba'i lam 'phrang brgyud pa'i bdag lus phung khams dang bcas bar yongs su 'khyud bzhin 'dug mi zhig 'tshar longs byung ba'i brgyud rim khrod nas rnyed pa'i mngar skyur kha gsum gyi grub pa'i tshor ba'i zin tho khag gis/ rgyal bstan rig gnas kyi rngams kha mthug pa'i bod mi rigs la zhabs 'degs dang dgos mkho ci yang med mod/ mi rang nyid la mtshon na tshe srog gi 'gul 'khyom khrod nas bzhur ba'i snyan ngag gi bla srog cig tu gyur 'dugatshor ba'i mkha' klong na dus kun lding bskor rgyags pa ni/ lo lnga'i steng nas pha mas re ba ltar mi tshe'i dbu 'khyud 'bri sa'i bdag gi 'khor yug la/ rnam dkar legs tshogs kyi bya ba zhig bsgrub par thabs shes yon tan dang 'jon thang nus shugs sogs phyogs gang thad nas ma 'dang bar/ mi lo nyi shu khad kyis zad pa'i lus gyi tho yor 'di mthong thengs rer/ sde 'di'i sngon byon mkhas grub rnams la sems gting nas dgongs dag cig yang yang zhu dgos byung / phran gyi thor rtsom phyogs 6༵sdus rnam rtog gi rba rlabs zhes

snyan deb thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba 'di la mtshon na/ dpe deb cig dpar bskrun bgyi ched glo bur du bris pa ma yin par/ rang nyid kyis snyan ngag 'bri ba'i kyag kyog gi lam 'phrang de'i 'go bzung ba nas da lta'i bar du bris ba phal cher phyogs bsdus byas ba zhig yin pas/ 'ga' re dus deb dang tshags shog sogs su bkod zin pa yin/ phran gyi rtsom deb 'di la sngon thon gyi bsam blo gsar ba dang / sgyu rtsal kyi mdzes nyams dod po gang yang med kyang / rang gshis kyi grub cha mang bo 'dus yod pas rdul dreg gi 'thab 'dzing bar nas phyungs te/ khyed klog pa bo rnams kyi spyan lam du bstar ba lags/ gal te deb chung 'di la legs pa'i cha zur tsam re mchis na/ rang nyid bskyed pa'i pha ma gnyis dang / mun pa sel ba'i slob dpon rnams kyi drin lan du 'gyur bar smon pa dang / gzhan pha ma gcig gi zhing khog brgyud pa'i nyam chung nga'i 'dun lam la thugs khur gnang mkhan bka' drin shin du zab pa'i rgyang ring gi a ce bso mkho la thugs rje che yang yang zhu ba dang chabs cig rang byung khams chen po'i srog ldan yod do cog 'tshe med dbu ma'i lam nas mthun zhing nang sems kyi longs spyod 'thob par shog cig ces rtsom pa bos dgon sde chen mo drug gi ya gyal sku 'bum byams pa gling nas sbyar ba dge'o//2007 12 567
